```{r}
library(Seurat)


# Read your object
# base_dir <- "~/1Work/RoseLab/Spatial/CAR_T/data/sc-reference"
base_dir <- "~/Roselab/Spatial/CAR_T/data/sc-reference/"
rds_file <- file.path(base_dir, "annotated.all.cells.RDS")

seurat_obj <- readRDS(rds_file)
```

```{r}
# Cell 1: inspect metadata + label counts

colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)

# Replace this with the correct column if needed:
label_col <- "sctype_classification"

table(seurat_obj@meta.data[[label_col]]) |> sort(decreasing = TRUE) |> head(20)

# Explicit counts for the key groups:
table(seurat_obj@meta.data[[label_col]])[c("CAR_T_cell","T_cell","B/T_cell")]

```

# Percentage of cells Analysis
```{r}
label_col <- "sctype_classification"   # change if needed

labs <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[label_col]]

# counts per cell type
ct <- table(labs, useNA = "ifany")

# percent per cell type
pct <- prop.table(ct) * 100

# % CAR T cells (exact match)
pct["CAR_T_cell"]

# (optional) show all cell types sorted by %
sort(pct, decreasing = TRUE)

```

```{r}
label_col <- "sctype_classification"
labs <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[label_col]]

ct  <- table(labs, useNA = "ifany")
pct <- prop.table(ct) * 100

celltype_summary <- data.frame(
  celltype = names(ct),
  n        = as.integer(ct),
  percent  = as.numeric(pct)
)

celltype_summary <- celltype_summary[order(-celltype_summary$percent), ]
celltype_summary

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

df <- celltype_summary
df$celltype <- reorder(df$celltype, df$percent)

ggplot(df, aes(x = celltype, y = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent of cells", title = "Cell type composition") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

```


```{r}
# Cell 2: check gene presence

genes <- c("Ptprc","Cd3d","Cd3e","Trac","Nkg7","Klrd1","Prf1","Gzmb",
           "Lyz2","S100a8","S100a9","Epcam","Krt8","Psca")

genes_present <- genes[genes %in% rownames(seurat_obj)]
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes, genes_present)

genes_present
genes_missing

```

```{r}
# Cell: force grouping by your metadata column (robust)

label_col <- "sctype_classification"

genes <- c("Ptprc","Cd3d","Cd3e","Nkg7","Klrd1","Prf1","Gzmb",
           "Lyz2","S100a8","S100a9","Epcam","Krt8","Psca")

genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(seurat_obj))

DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"

avg <- AverageExpression(
  seurat_obj,
  features = genes_present,
  group.by = label_col,   # <-- key change
  assays   = "RNA",
  slot     = "data"
)$RNA

# show what groups exist
print(dim(avg))
print(head(colnames(avg), 30))

```

```{r}
# groups x genes table like scanpy output
avg_t <- t(as.matrix(avg))

wanted <- c("CAR-T-cell","T-cell","NK-cell","Monocyte","Macrophage")
present <- intersect(wanted, rownames(avg_t))
present

avg_t[present, , drop = FALSE]


```

```{r}
genes2 <- c(
  # monocyte-like
  "Ly6c2","Ccr2","Plac8","S100a8","S100a9",
  # macrophage-like
  "Adgre1","C1qa","C1qb","C1qc","Apoe","Lpl","Mrc1",
  # DC-like
  "Itgax","Flt3","Xcr1",
  # general myeloid
  "Lyz2","Tyrobp"
)
genes2_present <- intersect(genes2, rownames(seurat_obj))

avg2 <- AverageExpression(
  seurat_obj,
  features = genes2_present,
  group.by = "sctype_classification",
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

avg2_t <- t(as.matrix(avg2))
avg2_t[c("CAR-T-cell","Monocyte","Macrophage","DC"), , drop = FALSE]

```

```{r}
genes_dc_like <- c(
  # APC / antigen presentation (DC-like hallmark)
  "Itgax","Cd74","H2-Ab1",
  # monocyte-derived / myeloid DC-ish
  "Itgam","Fcerg1","LST1","Lyz2","Tyrobp",
  # macrophage/TAM (should be low in CAR-T-cell)
  "Adgre1","C1qc","Lpl","Mrc1","Fcgr1",
  # cDC1 (should be low/weak)
  "Clec9a","Batf3","Irf8","Xcr1",
  # cDC2 (often Sirpa/Clec10a)
  "Sirpa","Clec10a",
  # pDC (should be low/weak)
  "Siglech","Tcf4","Irf7"
)

DotPlot(seurat_obj, features = genes_dc_like, group.by = "sctype_classification") + RotatedAxis()

```


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

Idents(seurat_obj) <- "sctype_classification"
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"

# Optional: order identities so CAR-T-cell is next to DC/Mono/Macro for comparison
lvl <- c("T-cell","NK-cell","B-cell","B/T-cell","DC","CAR-T-cell","Monocyte","Macrophage",
         "Neutrophils","Endothelial","Fibroblast","Erythrocyte")

genes_notT <- c("Cd3d","Cd3e","Cd247","Lck","Itk","Nkg7","Prf1","Gzmb","Lyz2","Tyrobp","Fcerg1","LST1")
genes_notT <- unique(intersect(genes_notT, rownames(seurat_obj)))
# A cleaner color scale for DotPlot (works well for figures)
dot_theme <- function(p) {
  p +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#f7fbff","#c6dbef","#6baed6","#2171b5","#08306b")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}


```

```{r}
# Cell: Plot 1 (Not T)

seurat_obj$sctype_ordered <- factor(
  seurat_obj$sctype_classification,
  levels = c("T-cell","NK-cell","B-cell","B/T-cell","DC","CAR-T-cell","Monocyte","Macrophage",
             "Neutrophils","Endothelial","Fibroblast","Erythrocyte")
)

p1 <- DotPlot(
  seurat_obj,
  features = genes_notT,
  group.by = "sctype_ordered",
  dot.scale = 7
) +
  ggtitle("CAR-T-cell cluster is not T (Cd3 genes absent; myeloid genes present)") +
  RotatedAxis()

dot_theme(p1)   # <- leave this as the LAST line to show it


```

```{r}
genes_notT <- c(
  # T cell core
  "Cd3d","Cd3e","Cd247","Lck","Itk",
  # cytotoxic/NK (to rule out "activated cytotoxic T")
  "Nkg7","Prf1","Gzmb",
  # myeloid backbone (what CAR-T-cell is showing)
  "Lyz2","Tyrobp","Fcerg1","LST1"
)
# 
# genes_notT <- intersect(genes_notT, rownames(seurat_obj))

p1 <- DotPlot(
  seurat_obj,
  features = genes_notT,
  group.by = "sctype_classification",
  cols = c("lightgrey", "navy"),   # overridden by scale below, but keeps Seurat happy
  dot.scale = 7
) +
  ggtitle("CAR-T-cell cluster is not T: lacks Cd3 genes and shows myeloid program") +
  RotatedAxis()

dot_theme(p1)

```

```{r}
# Plot 2: "DC-like / myeloid APC" marker panel

genes_dc_like <- c(
  # APC / antigen presentation
  "Itgax","Cd74","H2-Ab1",
  # myeloid backbone / moDC-ish
  "Lyz2","Tyrobp","Fcerg1","LST1","Itgam",
  # macrophage/TAM (should be low in this cluster)
  "Adgre1","C1qc","Lpl","Mrc1","Fcgr1",
  # cDC1
  "Clec9a","Batf3","Irf8","Xcr1",
  # cDC2
  "Sirpa","Clec10a",
  # pDC
  "Siglech","Tcf4","Irf7"
)

genes_dc_like <- unique(intersect(genes_dc_like, rownames(seurat_obj)))

p2 <- DotPlot(
  seurat_obj,
  features = genes_dc_like,
  group.by = "sctype_ordered",
  dot.scale = 7
) +
  ggtitle("CAR-T-cell cluster best matches DC-like / myeloid APC (Itgax+, MHC-II+)") +
  RotatedAxis()

print(dot_theme(p2))


```
